title: wkappbot ocr: screenshot-to-text, HTS owner-drawn, pipeline usage
desc: wkappbot ocr runs OCR on a window or image file. Pairs with a11y screenshot for focusless MFC/HTS owner-drawn control text extraction. Covers language options, subprocess usage, coordinate output, pipeline patterns.
steps: WHAT: wkappbot ocr <window-title-or-image.png> runs OCR on a window screenshot or an image file, prints recognized text with per-word coordinates. Pairs with a11y screenshot for focusless MFC/HTS owner-drawn control text extraction.

WHEN TO USE OCR vs a11y read: prefer a11y read (fast, exact, no image processing). Use OCR when a11y read returns empty for owner-drawn controls, text is rendered as image/bitmap, layout/position info is needed, or MFC HTS panels expose no UIA tree.

NAVIGATION: full usage detail (pipeline pattern, --lang options, Python subprocess usage, HTS owner-drawn fallback, coordinate-output click targeting) -> ocr-usage-howto. Dated live-fix incidents and restore-session harness escape-hatch notes -> ocr-usage-ref.

MAJOR FIX 2026-07-02: wkappbot ocr was returning 0 words for EVERY image because SimpleOcrAnalyzer had been a permanent no-op stub since commit d4efb8198 -- a 2026-04-21 IP-stripping commit deleted the whole WKAppBot.Vision project. Restored via commit 8d57caa04, v7.6.97: surgically brought back only the OCR-relevant subset from pre-strip commit 7ce85bcd1 -- SimpleOcrAnalyzer.cs, the real Windows.Media.Ocr WinRT engine not Tesseract, plus OcrSegmentCache.cs, OcrCorrectionDb.cs, VisionCache.cs, VisionCacheEntry.cs -- as a new minimal WKAppBot.Vision.csproj targeting net8.0-windows10.0.22621.0 with only a ProjectReference to WKAppBot.Win32, no Anthropic or SkiaSharp packages. ChartAnalyzer, VisionAnalyzer with its Claude Vision API fallback, CcaUiaFusedMatcher, TooltipCalibrator, DynamicA11yAnalyzer, and the entire WKAppBot.Android namespace remain stubbed, out of scope. Live-verified: 132 words on an agent test image, 184 words on a real terminal screenshot with mixed Korean and English text, via both wkappbot ocr directly and the new file read image auto-route. No Windows OCR language-pack blocker on this machine.

STDOUT/STDERR SPLIT 2026-07-02: OcrCommand output was restructured so extracted TEXT prints to stdout (clean, pipeable) while the Image header, OCR Results header, word count, and per-word coordinate lines all print to stderr -- mirrors the existing SaveCaptureResult convention in the same file (SAVED:path to stdout, [CAPTURE] diagnostics to stderr). Now 'wkappbot ocr img.png 2>/dev/null' or 'wkappbot file read img.png 2>/dev/null' yields pure extracted text with zero noise, matching Unix tool conventions (like pdftotext). Also extended the recognized-image-extension list from png/jpg/bmp to png/jpg/jpeg/bmp/gif/tif/tiff in BOTH OcrCommand's own file-type check and the file-read auto-router (they must stay in sync -- a mismatch here was found and fixed same session, where file-read routed .jpeg to ocr but OcrCommand's own check didn't recognize .jpeg as an image, which would have misrouted it as a window-title lookup).
EXTENSION+HELP UPDATE 2026-07-02 v7.6.99: commit lands the .jpeg/.gif/.tif/.tiff extension fix + stdout/stderr output split + updated ocr --help / CommandHelpMap text documenting both.
